case_number: Criminal Appeal No. of 2023 (Arising out of SLP (Crl) No. 7455 of 2019)

parties.respondent: The State of Andhra Pradesh & Anr.

summary: Cheque issued for time-barred debt; Section 25(3) Indian Contract Act applied; legally enforceable debt determination requires evidence; presumption under Section 139 NI Act not rebutted at quashing stage; High Court erred in quashing proceedings prematurely; matter remanded for trial.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment quashing proceedings set aside; criminal proceedings reinstated.
